source_name: Sociologický ústav AV ČR – press releases on financial behaviour surveys
why_relevant: The Institute of Sociology of the Czech Academy of Sciences co-runs surveys behind analyst-branded payment/financial-literacy outputs (identified as a partner in the 1,521-respondent August 2024 payment-behaviour survey and in financial-literacy work). Its press releases and PDFs often carry more methodological detail and more tables than the commercial partner's page.

source_name: Revo/Attitudes toward payment methods – international survey, Czech report (cs PDF)
why_relevant: A full Czech-language commissioned survey report on attitudes to payment methods (May 2022 wave) published openly as a PDF — an example of vendor-commissioned research that is freely downloadable in full rather than abstract-only, with question-level detail on payment-method preference.

Leading CZ business daily (Economia). Its byznys section carries bank earnings, client counts and market-share reporting, plus ATM-fleet stories; interviews with bank/vendor executives are often the only public record of fleet and share figures. Tag pages per bank exist (e.g. Raiffeisenbank).
Long-tail archive of HN articles — useful for reconstructing historical CZ card/ATM/market-share figures quoted over the years; surfaced separately in search results from the live site.

CZ business daily whose finance/banking desk publishes explicit 'v číslech' pieces with card counts, ATM counts and terminal figures (e.g. '12,2 milionu karet, 5461 bankomatů'), i.e. exactly the fleet-level numbers this workstream needs.

Weekly business magazine from the HN stable; long-form banking/payments features and executive interviews that typically carry market-share estimates and vendor commentary unavailable elsewhere. Listed in cell scope; not directly fetched this run.

The only dedicated CZ professional banking magazine (65+ years, published by 4H Production since 2013), covering regulation, banking, fintech and payments; the natural home for vendor/bank interviews with fleet, channel and market-share numbers.
Publisher-independent listing of Bankovnictví magazine issue tables of contents; a cheap way to index which issues contain payments/cards/ATM articles before paying for the issue.

source_name: Lupa.cz — Banky / Fintech / Platební systém sections
why_relevant: Internet/tech trade server with standing tag sections for banks, fintech and payment systems; covers CZ instant payments, PSD2/API, fintech funding and market-share claims by challengers (e.g. Twisto targets).

Startup/business outlet that publishes explainer pieces with merchant-economics detail (e.g. what a merchant pays to accept cards — MDR/interchange breakdowns) and fintech deal coverage; such fee-level detail is rarely public elsewhere in CZ.

CZ financial-product comparison and award site (accounts, cards, fees, rates) — a structured, recurring source of bank pricing/fee data and product-level market commentary usable as a proxy for competitive positioning.

Fee-focused CZ portal that compares bank charges from actual published sazebníky (price lists) rather than marketing; useful for tracking ATM withdrawal fees, card issuance fees and acquiring-adjacent charges over time.

CZ banking news/comparison site that republishes and interprets SBK/ČNB card and terminal statistics in article form (e.g. record 18.1m cards, contactless growth) — a convenient dated, quotable trail of headline market numbers.
Mainstream CZ news site with a consistent multi-year record of annual SBK card/ATM statistic write-ups; valuable for time-series of headline figures and for its finance wiki on accounts and fees.

CZ retail trade magazine — the demand-side view of POS: terminal penetration in stores, self-checkout rollouts, cash vs card at the till, vendor commentary. Complements bank-side sources for ATM/POS fleet intelligence.

High-frequency CZ finance news feed that reports bank product/channel changes at operational granularity (e.g. ATM feature rollouts such as EUR banknote deposits at Moneta) — early signal for ATM fleet capability changes.
CZ financial/economic commentary site tied to a financial group; useful for macro-financial framing and occasional fintech/payments commentary, weaker on hard payment statistics.

Commercial portal that mirrors ČNB ARAD payment-statistics series (card counts by function, acceptance devices) in easier-to-scrape HTML tables; a practical bridge between press coverage and the primary ČNB series.

source_name: Inspirum blog — nezávislé srovnání poskytovatelů platebních terminálů
why_relevant: Vendor-comparison write-up of CZ payment-terminal providers with pricing and provider landscape; commercially motivated but a rare consolidated public view of acquirer/terminal-provider competition in CZ.

Public-service broadcaster newsroom; reliable, non-paywalled coverage of ČNB/SBK statistics releases and bank sector developments, useful as a free corroboration layer for paywalled HN/Ekonom reporting.

source_name: Zlatá koruna — soutěž finančních produktů (award programme)
why_relevant: Annual Czech financial-product award with a payment-cards / innovation category; entry write-ups and jury materials describe new card, wallet and POS/acceptance products, often quoting volumes, user counts and launch dates months before any official statistic. Category lists year-on-year map which product areas issuers are pushing.

source_name: Mastercard Banka roku (formerly Fincentrum Banka roku) — official site
why_relevant: The dominant Czech bank award; categories include Mobilní aplikace roku pro banky, Fintech roku, Insurtech roku. Winner announcements (e.g. 24th edition, 27 Nov 2025: Česká spořitelna as bank of the year, Tapix by Dateio as Fintech roku, Air Bank mobile app) surface which digital/payment platforms are considered market-leading and which fintechs banks are partnering with.

source_name: Nejlepší banka / Ceny Hospodářských novin (HN bank awards)
why_relevant: Second, editorially independent Czech bank-award track run by Hospodářské noviny; results pages and accompanying journalism give a cross-check on the Banka roku ranking and often reference digital/payment metrics used as judging criteria.

source_name: cardforum® — SBK annual card & payments conference
why_relevant: The main Czech/Slovak card-industry conference (Seč / Krkonoše rotation, Hotel Jezerka). Programme PDFs name speakers, their employers and session titles — a direct read on which banks are migrating processing platforms, deploying softPOS, or rolling out scheme mandates. Session titles are a leading indicator of what statistics will exist next year.
Second SBK event format aimed at CZ/SK plus foreign card and technology experts; registration and programme pages reveal cross-border vendor and scheme participation in the Czech card market.

source_name: cardmag® — Czech card industry trade magazine (SBK)
why_relevant: Trade magazine of the card association; interviews and vendor articles routinely cite terminal counts, transaction volumes and project timelines as credentials. Historic issues are partially mirrored on document-sharing sites.

source_name: Trendy v platebním styku ČR & SR — annual payments conference
why_relevant: Agenda for the 2026 edition explicitly covers PSD3/PSR implementation, tokenisation, the EU digital identity wallet, modern payment infrastructure and CZ/SK interoperability, and AI agents in payments — i.e. an ordered list of the regulatory and infrastructure changes that will reshape Czech payment statistics in the next 24 months.

source_name: FinTech Roadmap (Fintree / ČNB congress centre) — annual Czech fintech conference
why_relevant: Fifth edition held 14 May 2026 at the Czech National Bank congress centre, sold out with 400+ participants and 40+ speakers from fintechs, banks, investors, regulators. Speaker roster and session list is a high-density actor map and an early read on regulatory and product direction; the ČNB venue signals regulator engagement.
